plainTranslation: Their Neptune in your 12th house: a deep spiritual or imaginative bond - dreamy, compassionate, boundary-dissolving, easy to idealize completely. Failure mode: total illusion, escapism, losing yourself entirely. Let it be a deep connection; stay grounded enough to see clearly.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
